sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Limit switch circuit open. If the limit does not close within 3 minutes, the furnace goes into a 1-hour soft lockout.
causes: Firing rate not correct for the furnace
diySteps: Turn the furnace off and make sure return and supply grilles are open and nothing is blocking them
Technician: check firing rate, look for a blockage in the heater, and check airflow. The code resumes after the fault is cleared
proAdvice: E250 names firing rate and a blockage in the heater, which are not a filter swap by themselves. E291 is the row that names a dirty filter. If E250 returns, or the furnace goes into the 1-hour lockout, call a licensed HVAC technician.
